desc:
Members of the Ceremonial Claimant Faction support a pretender as the Realm's Ceremonial Monarch

Ultimatum
The Claimant replaces the Ceremonial Monarch, and the Faction Leader replaces the Ruling Regent, and takes all their Landed Titles
name: Ceremonial Claimant Faction

desc: Members of the claimant Faction supports a pretender targeting a title belonging to their Liege.
name: Claimant Faction

desc:
Members of the Dissolution Faction Faction seek to destroy the realm of their Liege.

Ultimatum
All Faction Members become Independent
Liege loses their Primary Title and other Titles of the same Tier
name: Dissolution Faction
shortEffect: Wants to destroy the Realm of their Liege

desc: The Escalated Peasant Faction wants freedom from unjust rule, and will seek independence from their liege.
name: Escalated Peasant Faction

desc:
Members of the Imperial Policy Faction support adopting a new Imperial Policy for the Realm

Ultimatum
The Faction Leader selects a new Imperial Policy for the Realm
name: Imperial Policy Faction
shortEffect: Wants to change the Imperial Policy

desc:
Members of the Independence Faction seek independence from their Liege.

Ultimatum
All Faction Members become Independent
Liege loses Prestige
name: Independence Faction

desc:
Members of the Install Ruling Regent Faction seek to forcibly oust the current Ruling Regent.

Ultimatum
The Faction Leader replaces the current Ruling Regent, and takes all their Landed Titles
name: Install Ruling Regent Faction

desc: The Liberty Faction seeks to lower Crown Authority, Tribal Authority, or Imperial Bureaucracy, but members are otherwise loyal to the Realm.
name: Liberty Faction

desc: The Nomadic Faction wants to be ruled by a Nomadic Ruler whos Nomadic Capital shares their Culture and Faith.
name: Nomadic Faction
shortEffect: Wants to establish new Nomadic Realms

desc: The Peasant Faction wants freedom for the people from foreign or infidel rule, and will strive to replace a liege who does not share the Culture and Faith of the commoners in the Counties.
name: Peasant Faction

desc: The Populist Faction wants freedom from foreign or infidel rule, and will seek independence from a liege who does not share their Culture or Faith.
name: Populist Faction

desc:
Members of the Restore Ceremonial Monarch Faction seek to oust the Ruling Regent and re-establish direct rule by the Ceremonial Monarch.

Ultimatum
The Ceremonial Monarch replaces the Ruling Regent, takes all their Landed Titles, and adopts Primogeniture Succession
name: Restore Ceremonial Monarch Faction
shortEffect: Wants to restore the Ceremonial Monarch to power
